purpose: Owner-approved Phase 3B visual baseline for subsequent development-only type artwork production. Approval applies to the art direction, not to unseen individual type assets and not to C01D public activation.

owner_reviewed_source.note: The exact owner-reviewed source was generated during the design review session. The repository commits a reduced archival reference preview; production masters must be generated/exported separately at contract dimensions and undergo per-asset review.

visual_direction.character_priority: A believable person in a specific lived-in situation is the primary visual identity; decorative props are secondary.
visual_direction.environment: Naturalistic, imperfect, inhabited spaces with plausible object placement and ordinary wear. Avoid stage-like fantasy ateliers, symmetrical prop walls and exhibition-display clutter.
visual_direction.composition: Editorial photograph/illustration sensibility with asymmetry, incidental occlusion, practical camera height and negative space. Avoid centered hero posing, beauty-shot framing and generic cinematic poster composition.
visual_direction.character_rendering: Commercial-quality 2D/naturalistic illustration or photographic-editorial realism, with restrained retouching, ordinary body language and non-performative expressions.
visual_direction.lighting: Available-light or motivated practical-light feeling; avoid golden magical haze, rim-light overload, neon glow and glossy synthetic skin.
visual_direction.props: Use only a few scene-credible objects that support the motif. Do not literalize every code component as an icon array.
visual_direction.texture: Real material texture, paper, fabric, wood, metal and environmental wear; avoid AI-like micro-detail noise and decorative overpopulation.
visual_direction.series_consistency_rule: Consistency comes from editorial treatment, tonal discipline, crop behavior and motif logic—not from reusing the same room, pose, face archetype or prop layout.

anti_ai_artifact_rules: no generic wistful beauty portrait as default pose
no repeated chin-in-hand pose across the catalog
no fantasy scholar atelier as a universal background
no cinematic golden-hour glow as a universal look
no hyper-detailed texture noise used to simulate quality
no identical face template across types
no visible text or pseudo-writing inside final production master art
no impossible hands, duplicate objects, fused accessories or inconsistent reflections
